popCulture.title: Maera (hound)
popCulture.description: Icarius' faithful dog who found her murdered master — later linked with Canicula and the Dog Star in the Attic calendar of the wine-gift myth.

popCulture.title: Canicula
popCulture.description: The 'little dog' of the summer heat — a Latin name that later astronomy and almanacs fold into Maera's and Sirius' canine sky.
